info.title: Wintek ATM SIP Command Center API
info.description: Operator-initiated SIP intercom management for ATM fleets. All endpoints except auth/login, auth/refresh, auth/logout and system/live need a Bearer access token; permissions are enforced server-side. Errors use {code, message, details?, correlationId}. Real-time events: WebSocket /ws (see docs/realtime-events.md).

accessExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

provisionSip.description: Create the SIP identity and return its password once

targetId.description: Region, group or operator id depending on action; null clears SET_PRIMARY/SET_BACKUP

expectedVersion.description: Version you edited; a mismatch returns 409 STALE_VERSION

externalRef.description: External incident id, e.g. from the VMS

requestId.description: Client-generated idempotency key (UUID recommended). Retries with the same key return the same call.

queueIfBusy.description: If the ATM is busy, queue the request (when policy permits) instead of failing

queueItemId.description: Queue item this call fulfils (accepting an offer)

orgId.description: Omit for platform default (super admin only)
